summary: Iteration 6 (file iteration_5): Verified new Print Settings + Packet Labels feature. Added TestPrintSettings (5 tests) and TestPacketLabels (3 tests) to backend_test.py. Full backend regression: 45/45 pytest tests pass. Frontend UI (Playwright) verified: admin sees nav-print-settings, defaults A4/portrait/10mm/2x1/barcode-on/bh24 render correctly, presets set width/height, saving A5/landscape/8/1.5x1 persists across reload (GET returns saved values), barcode switch off hides SVG barcode and on restores it, /labels page renders exactly N stickers per packet, copies=3 renders 3 copies and button label reads 'Print 3 Labels', sticker sizing honours saved 3x1 (helper text 'Sticker size 3in x 1in'), Print all labels & per-row print-label-{no} present on kapan stock table, empty ids shows 'No packets selected for labels' UI (frontend does not call API when ids empty), staff@polki.com does NOT see nav-print-settings but can GET /settings/print and view /labels page. Print settings restored to defaults (A4/portrait/10mm/2x1/barcode-on/bh24).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: PUT /api/settings/print stores whole payload with _id='print'; GET merges over defaults - clean. Consider validating jangad_margin_mm >= 0 explicitly (currently accepts negatives).
Labels.jsx: When ids param is empty, no API call fires and empty state is shown client-side; backend still returns 400 for GET /api/packets/labels?ids= as required.
PacketLabel.jsx: seq shown top-left as-is (numeric). If seq missing, would render empty; acceptable given seq is always set on packet creation.
server.py handles ObjectId serialization correctly via serialize().
seed_data_creation: Used existing kapan 101.35 packet 101.35-03 for label rendering. Backend TestPacketLabels creates its own TEST_ prefixed kapan/packets.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Print settings persist doc _id='print' in db.settings collection. Restore defaults after destructive tests. Radix selects need ~400ms after opening. Labels sizing pulls settings from GET /api/settings/print (available to all authed users). 45 backend tests are the current baseline; keep them passing.
